description: This file contains Go source code defining mock objects and test functions for the Kubernetes runtime testing framework, specifically for testing CacheableObject interface implementations.

classes.name: noncacheableTestObject
classes.description: A mock object implementing json.Marshaler, proto.Marshaler, and runtime.Object interfaces for testing purposes.

classes.name: MockCacheableObject
classes.description: A mock object implementing runtime.CacheableObject and runtime.Object interfaces for testing cache encoding behavior.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Implements json.Marshaler interface, returns a fixed JSON string.

methods.name: Marshal
methods.description: Implements proto.Marshaler interface, returns a fixed proto string.

methods.name: DeepCopyObject
methods.description: Unimplemented method that panics if called.

methods.name: GetObjectKind
methods.description: Returns the object itself as its ObjectKind.

methods.name: CacheEncode
methods.description: Mocks encoding of the object, intercepts calls, and writes a result or error based on internal flags.

methods.name: GetObject
methods.description: Returns the object itself or a non-cacheable object based on internal flags.

methods.name: interceptedCalls
methods.description: Returns the list of intercepted runtime.Identifier calls.
